Imagine if everyone had a well funded HSA and could self pay 🤔 

That everyone could get such large cash paying discounts 🧐

The free market is the answer. 

Imagine thousands of associations across the country all competing, all innovating, all serving local people to the best of their ability instead of a one size fits all national program. 

Get government out of healthcare. It is incapable of micromanaging healthcare for over 345,000,000 people.  It’s an impossible task. 

Obamacare is a disaster in the making. The huge costs are not sustainable and will bankrupt the country while abandoning millions without any healthcare whatsoever. 

Every government program is riddled with corruption. Medicaid. SNAP. Obamacare.  Medicare. On and on and on….

This is the best plan for free market healthcare. Better care. Lower rates. Better cash flow for all healthcare providers. 

Form healthcare associations similar to credit unions in the financial world. Members join for small fees and enroll their HSAs with these health care unions. 

Employers pay, tax free, directly into employee’s HSAs the same amounts thst insurance currently costs….say $1,500 -$2,500   More for family coverage.  This could quickly build significant reserves for both individuals and families. 

For people below average income, we currently spend approximately $1.4 trillion…..that TRILLION…. per year!  We could use much of that of that for direct contributions to individual accounts. This would give them better care at lower cost without the dizzying array of the government maze of rules, regulations and paperwork. 

These associations then negotiate with providers for discounted fees. Imagining services, radiology, blood work, dialysis, everything. With several thousand members they can negotiate volume discounts by delivering bulk business. 

Service providers get same day pay, eliminating massive paper work costs and delays. They will reduce staff that currently file forms, do billing, argue contested services, and a greatly improved business cash flow. 

For patients it means no need for ‘prior approval’ from insurance companies. Quicker flow of services without those delays.  Greater confidence in the system.  And the ability to seek specialized care for difficult situations that are otherwise difficult to access. 

Allow multiple, independent associations in every city to compete with each other, to offer choices to consumers, to reward those that offer ghe best services at the best prices. They could also form alliances to negotiate better terms. 

When a member needs a service his/her PCP writes a script, patient gets service, then he/she uses a debit card based on their HSA to make a same day payment. Clean. Simple. Fast. Better. 

This allows consumers to purchase services as needed including ‘out of network’ unlike current restrictions by conglomerate insurance systems. People could use it nationally if they need services while on vacation of traveling for business. Perhaps even internationally as the system developed confidence. 

Individuals pay for service as needed at much lower rates but carry high deductible catastrophic coverage for major events.  With deductibles of $25,000 or even $50,000…..depending on amount in HSA…..the cost would be minimal.  

Purely 💯 optional. Faster service.  Discounted rate for both volume from the healthcare union and for instant cash payment.  No complicated forms. Less staff needed. Better cash flow. 

There are many more huge benefits that are too many to discuss here. 

Allows people to change jobs without losing healthcare or changing their entire medical team. 

Allows people to start their own business and maintain their health care. 

Protects people by continuing their healthcare when businesses close or downsize. 

Greatly delays people from needing Medicaid. 

Covers long term nursing home care easing the burden on Medicare.  

Lots more benefits to this proposal too numerous to go into.
